NOTE
**Still not ready: commits were squashed, but the commit messages and screenshots still fall short**

New: The author squashed the history from four commits to two and says the commit messages were rewritten, and offered a screen recording for the screenshots. Missing: the commit subjects are still "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418" (wrong issue number, no Zulip-style `markdown:` prefix, and the test is in a separate commit from the fix), and there are still no precise before/after screenshots. The tab change is visible in the rendered and copied code block, so the screenshot guidance applies.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm, who gave the feedback, follow up when the author pushes again.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The commit messages still don't follow our [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (a `markdown:` style subject, and the test belongs in the same commit as the fix), and the change does show up in the rendered code block, so please follow our guide on [precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
